record.title: Microduck right foot cap — mirror of microduck-foot-left about x=0 (measured true mirror, p95 0.000 mm): same comb, cradle, snaps, pockets, M2 pilot
record.origin_why: v0.0.2 is a parametric rebuild: foot_right.stl is foot_left.stl mirrored about x=0 (point-to-triangle p95 0.000 mm, max 0.005 mm — out/measure/foot/measure2.py); every number in cad/part.py was measured off Pollen Robotics’ decimated visual mesh (CC BY-SA-NC sim asset) with cecad.meshslice intervals/segments and cecad.meshfeatures (probe scripts in out/measure/foot/); nobody has Pollen’s CAD and no physical part has been measured. v0.0.1 (kept) was the vendor mesh loaded as-is.
record.why: cad/part.py builds one valid solid (bin/cad part:microduck-foot-right) and ce-cad/bin/cad-refcheck grades it against Pollen’s own published mesh reference/pollen-microduck-rl/assets/foot_right.stl: p95 0.37/0.26 mm, median 0.000/0.000, bbox delta [-0.001, 0.0, -0.004] mm, 2/2 holes matched. The report is the ledger artifact (evidence/refcheck/).
record.why_this_folder_exists: The right foot of the Microduck (MJCF places foot_right once, on body ankle_right). A separate folder because the assembly refs a part per side; the geometry is one hand flip away from microduck-foot-left.
